openings.claim: Reversible strip stops may improve lateral registration independently of deliberate corner tightening; an engagement comparison can test their contribution.
openings.delta: Keep padded rim clamps but make their lateral stops withdrawable. Compare engaged and withdrawn stops with identical centered seal seating and no deliberate corner preload. Drill or cut only supplied strips; tether removable parts outside the inspection opening.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: residual seal friction or clamp-induced compression explains registration. If stops contribute, engaged pulls show stop contact with less displacement than withdrawn pulls under matched ordinary and right-card conditions. Similar displacement, absent contact or clamp movement defeats that inference. Contact alone cannot establish load share.
openings.probe: First verify actual rim geometry, bolt reach and strip fabrication permit nondeforming clamps, withdrawable stops and unobstructed opening. Park if infeasible. Use two configurations: ten engaged opening/closure/20 N pull cycles, final cycle disturbed; two withdrawn trials, one ordinary and one disturbed. Record displacement, stop contact, clamp migration, opposite-corner lift, tears and reopening time using supplied instruments and marker witness lines. The engaged candidate must meet every outcome after ten cycles; comparisons provide only limited causal evidence. Stop on damage; completion also requires fabrication within ninety minutes and observation within twenty minutes.
assumptions: Unprovided rim access, bolt lengths and strip stiffness permit attachment and withdrawal using four strips, six bolts, four pads and cord.
Withdrawal leaves seal seating and clamp compression comparable; otherwise the rival comparison is confounded.
Defeat includes riding over stops, clamp migration, disturbed rocking beyond 1 mm registration, tears, permanent deformation, obstructed inspection, lost parts or reopening beyond 30 seconds.
Two comparator trials cannot establish repeatability; no supplied observation proves performance.

assessment: One feasibility-dependent probe; deployment remains unsupported. Stop contact and comparison results must be interpreted alongside unchanged seating and clamp stability.

lineage.reason: Replace ordinary corner-pressing comparison with stop withdrawal to interrogate the residual-friction explanation.

attacks.dependency: Successful unpreloaded registration is attributed to lateral bearing despite residual friction.
